name: LA Peptides Universal Label Template
description: Single, machine-readable entry point for this package. Read this file first: it lists every canonical source, derived deliverable, placeholder asset, schema, and doc in the package, plus the full set of editable region/field ids, so a web app, the sales app, or a backend tool can discover what's here and how to use it without inspecting the filesystem.

derivedDeliverables.note: All three are reproducible from canonicalSources via `npm run build:master` — see buildTooling below. Do not hand-edit them; edit master-label.svg/label-spec.json/a theme and rebuild instead.

buildTooling.usage: node scripts/build.js --theme <theme.json> [--fields <field-map.json>] --out <dir> [--zip]. Omitting --fields keeps master-label.svg's neutral placeholders (this is how the derivedDeliverables above are produced). Applying a field-map builds one specific brand partner's finished label — every field-map key is one of the fieldIds below.

idConvention: Every id above is used identically as: the SVG element id in master-label.svg, the fieldKey/elementId pair in label-spec.json's "fields" registry, and the region id in layout.json's "regions" array. One flat, snake_case identifier per editable thing, consistent across all three files — that is the whole integration contract.
notes: No real or fictional brand identity is represented anywhere in this package — every value is a neutral placeholder.
This is a template package only: no app, website, database, login system, or ordering portal is included.
Independent of the sales app, website, pricing tools, and market-analysis work elsewhere in this repository.
